character.locked_description: Maya is a nine-year-old South Asian girl with a slender build, warm brown skin, and dark curly hair tied high on her head. She has a round face with dark eyes. She wears a teal windbreaker, black fingerless gloves, dark jeans, and bright sneakers. A small adjustable wrench hangs from a lanyard around her neck. At rest, she sits upright and balanced in a lightweight manual wheelchair. The wheelchair features bright orange spoke guards and a black toolkit strapped securely under the seat, functioning as a custom extension of her daily gear.
